column1: # MarkerCodex bulk import template. Documentation lines beginning with # are ignored during import.
# species [required]: Scientific species name such as Homo sapiens.
# species_common_name: Familiar species name such as human.
# gene_symbol [required]: Official gene symbol such as MS4A1.
# gene_aliases: Alternative gene names separated by semicolons such as CD20
# stable_id: Stable gene identifier such as an Ensembl gene ID.
# major_cell_type [required]: Broad identity such as B cell or macrophage.
# cell_subtype: More specific identity such as naive B cell
# ontology_id: Cell Ontology identifier for the subtype or major type such as CL:0000236.
# marker_direction: positive or negative
# tissue: Tissue where the marker claim applies
# condition: Disease treatment or biological condition
# developmental_stage: Developmental or age stage
# assay: Evidence assay such as scRNA-seq or CITE-seq
# confidence: low moderate or high
# bbsr_verified: true only after BBSR review
# submitter: Person or team that submitted the assertion.
# notes: Free-text curator context about the marker assertion.
# source_title: Title of the supporting publication or database record.
# citation: Formatted citation for the source.
# doi: Digital Object Identifier without a https://doi.org/ prefix.
# pmid: PubMed identifier.
# url: Direct source URL.
# evidence_type: reported_marker differential_expression figure table expert_review or other.
# evidence_location: Figure table supplement page or section locating the evidence.
# evidence_note: Free-text explanation of how the source supports the assertion.
